name: io.github.borglayerdev/borglayer-mcp
description: Search, appraise & buy domains across 5 chains (USDC/USDT/USD1/USDG) via verified escrow.

authentication.instructions: Get an API key at https://borglayer.com — pass as Authorization: Bearer blk_live_...

tools.name: create_checkout
tools.description: Create an escrow checkout on the chosen chain + stablecoin (Base/Arbitrum/Polygon USDC, BNB USDC/USDT/USD1, Robinhood USDG). Requires checkout.write scope + spending limit.

tools.name: list_chains
tools.description: List supported chains + stablecoins for payment, each with its verified escrow contract
